text:
<subject>RE: message from Santa</subject>
<body>
Certainly! All the lists are currently being compiled. Could you please send your list as well?

I planned to wait until Advent to share L's portrait—is that alright with you? I CAN send it earlier if you prefer. Her school photos have arrived too.

Apologies for not returning your call last evening. We were busy toy shopping with Grandma Helga, then it was time for dinner, and later received a call from Oma, who immediately started sharing all her health concerns. Did Dreamy Erik meet your expectations?

-----Original Message-----
From: susan.meyer@nordwindenergie.de [mailto:susan.meyer@nordwindenergie.de]
Sent: Monday, November 13, 2000 14:02
To: karin.schmidt@nordwindenergie.de
Subject: message from Santa

Santa is heading to the Black Forest just before Christmas and would like to complete gift preparations before the trip... not to mention Santa’s busy schedule of festivities once December begins... wish lists for you, Jens, and P-nut would be greatly appreciated!
</body>
